title: Decompose Progress timeline presentation
summary: Decomposes the read-only Progress WebView facade into bounded responsibility modules while preserving the mediaPipelineProgressView API.
reason: progressView.js had accumulated unrelated timeline, telemetry, evidence, detail, audit, and rendering responsibilities, making safe maintenance difficult.
behavior_before: The Progress facade contained multiple independent UI projections and rendering models in one oversized file.
behavior_after: The facade is a 414-line wiring layer; each Progress child module owns one bounded projection or presentation responsibility and remains below 500 lines.
manual_validation: Browser diagnostics handoff smoke exceeded its 120-second command timeout after startup; no failure output was emitted.
Focused Node syntax checks and 28 WebView static tests passed.
rollback_plan: Restore the previous Progress facade and remove the extracted Progress child script includes and modules. This refactor is read-only and does not affect media, runtime state, queue state, or backend policy.
notes: Consolidates the bounded Progress facade decomposition: parent 414 lines; all Progress child modules are under 500 lines.
